scripts.assets: rm -rf public/assets && cp -r ../docs/shield/video-assets public/assets && node scripts/gen-terminal.mjs
scripts.studio: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.still: npm run assets && remotion still src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts ShieldVideo out/shield-video.mp4
scripts.transcribe: [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && .venv/bin/python scripts/transcribe.py || echo 'Setup once: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install faster-whisper'
